fee_notes: $36,000 for Schedule B package (no tile equipment); $41,900 for Schedule A package. Multiple concurrent territories: $19,900 each additional. Existing franchisees in good standing: $18,000 each additional. $1,000 veteran discount on first territory.
raw_excerpt: The Initial Franchise Fee is $36,000 to $41,900 for your first franchise territory purchased, depending on the initial equipment package purchased.
